digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow dispatch
propositions: GitHub Actions runner queue depth peaks at 22 waiting jobs during Gerrit Verified dispatch bursts despite Free plan 20-job concurrency ceiling, indicating org-level contention or provisioning delay.
Current gerrit-verify.yaml workflow executes 17-24 runner jobs per patchset (13-job immediate fan-out after classify), consuming 65-117 runner-minutes per run and saturating macOS concurrency.
Observed incident-period burst (2026-08-13 20:30 UTC, seven runs in five minutes) queued up to 873s runner wait despite tickets branch pushes producing zero Actions runs.

Four mutually exclusive first-move remediation options exist: bundle four Ubuntu preflights and cap mutation matrix (Option A, coverage-neutral demand reduction, recommended), extend patchset debounce (Option B, low incremental value), move macOS to scheduled branch health (Option C, weakens pre-merge coverage), or upgrade org plan (Option D, recurring cost).
Remeasure shared-org queue depth and latency after any capacity/workflow change is selected and approved by operator.
